title: Commercial Hotel, toll bridge
description: This photograph, taken from Carr’s Hill, showcases the uncovered bridge and its toll booth, offers a partial glimpse of Main Street shops, including the distinctive cupola atop C. Humphrey Taylor’s store and, in the foreground, highlights the prominent Commercial Hotel situated across from the railroad tracks. (Courtesy of  Buddy Barss)
